feeds.title: Kiwi Kids News
feeds.description: Kiwi Kids News is a company that provides an educational website for students, teachers and families. Kiwi Kids News aims to make the site student-friendly and safe while offering an entertaining environment, where students can find the latest news and current events.

feeds.title: Tots to Teens
feeds.description: Tots to Teens is a NZ based, ideas-driven magazine for the parents of 0 to 12 year-olds. They have regular nutrition, technology, financial and education-based articles; along with parenting and pregnancy/new baby information. They have book reviews (with book giveaways), book club giveaways, product reviews (with giveaways); as well.

feeds.title: Kiwi Families
feeds.description: New Zealand's trusted parenting website for more than 10 years. We've been serving up free tips, tools and advice from some of the best New Zealand parenting experts, to help grow great families in New Zealand, and around the world.Kiwi Families is brought to you by us, Jarrod and Alayna (oh and our kids Saige and Maani make the odd appearance too!).

feeds.title: Kidspot
feeds.description: Owned and operated by New Zealand mums, Kidspot is designed to be clean and intuitive, taking the hassle out of the search for parenting information - meaning parents can spend more quality time with their family as a result. Kidpsot has become New Zealand's most comprehensive online resource for parents, covering everything from conception through to the teenage years.

feeds.title: ChildLife Essentials Blog
feeds.description: Childlife Essentials is a supplement brand exclusively for babies, infants and children, offering a complete nutritional range. In this blog, you will find tips about how to keep your child healthy, good eating habits and much more.

feeds.title: Pregnancy Bump & Baby
feeds.description: If you're looking for information about pregnancy in New Zealand, BUMP and baby Magazine is your place for pregnancy information and babyhood.

feeds.title: Poetry Box
feeds.description: The blog is a New Zealand poetry page for children brought to you by Paula Green, who has published 11 books based on poetry.

feeds.title: Kids Books NZ Blog
feeds.description: Kids Book NZ Blog reviews books because they are passionate about promoting New Zealand children's books. They promote children's books written by New Zealand authors. They will do their best to cover as many titles as possible even if this takes them a while. They appreciate your understanding in this matter. Go through their blog to learn more about their work.

feeds.title: Mud Mates Blog
feeds.description: Join us as we have fun exploring different activities for kids of all ages. Fun, simple messy play, sensory play, science experiments, arts & crafts & more! Authored by Alana Steyn.

feeds.title: The Confident Eater
feeds.description: The Confident Eater provides information about getting children eating.

feeds.title: Auckland For Kids News
feeds.description: Auckland For Kids brings you the best of everything in Auckland, New Zealand for children, teens and families. The best of what's on each weekend in Auckland for kids and families, Auckland family attractions, after school classes and activities, Sports activities, Toddler and preschool classes, Kid friendly cafes and restaurants in Auckland and much more.

feeds.title: My Kids Party Blog
feeds.description: Your guide to fabulous kid's parties. One location online where you can find all your kid's party planning needs. Through the blog you can connect with party supplies and services by clicking onto the vendor list and being taken to their website.

feeds.title: Hoopla Kids Blog
feeds.description: Hoopla Kids is about fun clothes for fun kids. They sell Scandinavian kids clothing that is colourful, creative, fun and of high quality that will last well beyond one child.

feeds.title: Squoodles Blog
feeds.description: Follow this blog to get posts about wooden educational toys and gifts for kids.

feeds.title: Tutoring for Excellence Blog
feeds.description: The tutors strive to create a one-to-one learning environment which reaches out to the student in a way that the group classroom experience cannot. They work with the students to carefully design a program tailored exclusively to them and their chosen subject, in order to help them achieve the best results possible.

feeds.title: Belinda Lansley Photography Blog
feeds.description: Belinda Lansley Photography is a photography blog by Belinda who specializes in child photography and loves to capture the fine art portrait of your child.

feeds.title: KidsedchatNZ
feeds.description: KidsedchatNZ is the official account for schools in New Zealand. The aim of KidsedchatNZ is to motivate kids to be active, engaged and connected learners.

feeds.title: Nature Library
feeds.description: I'm Kathy Broadhead (MEd, PGDipT, BSc), I am a qualified and experienced environmental educator with over 20 years working in a variety of education roles in NZ and abroad. I am passionate about collaborative learning between children, educator,s and nature. My programs combine child-led learning, free nature play, and intentional learning experiences to support the development of the whole child.

feeds.title: Gillian Candler Blog
feeds.description: Gillian Candler writes factual books for children and adults, mostly about the natural world in New Zealand. In Children's book category you will find her giving her opinions on top picks from kids books and tips on writing books for kids.

feeds.title: Breakfast Club Kids New
feeds.description: Breakfast Club was formed in Randwick Park, Manurewa with the intention of feeding breakfast to children to enable to reach their potential in their schooling.

feeds.title: Happy Mum Happy Child Blog
feeds.description: Happy Mum Happy Child was started in July 2014, to document the activities Maria did with her children. Since then it has grown into a community for Parents to share their ups and downs and have a good laugh. Join her in this journey as a parent who struggles daily with life and depression.

feeds.title: Wellington City Libraries » 'Kids' stories
feeds.description: WCL has over 600,000 books, 450,000 magazines, and 85,000 CDs, DVDs, videos and other items at their central library and 11 branches. The Library includes number of educational and entertaining articles for kids and teens. They post heaps of interesting stuff, like what's on for kids, great books, and gross facts. There is lots of other interesting stuff like reviews, cool internet links, and help with homework.

feeds.title: OMGTech Blog
feeds.description: OMGTech is a technology blog for kids to learn about new technologies. It is all about enabling kids to access the future technology today. You will find Robots, nano, biotech, rockets, programming and much more.

feeds.title: My Kid's Party Blog
feeds.description: My Kid's Party is your curated guide to kid's parties in New Zealand.

feeds.title: Outdoorsy Blog
feeds.description: Outdoorsy provides posts about spending time in nature way for Mums to energise, revitalise and regain clarity and also created an online community dedicated to fun, inspiring ways to kick the cabin fever and get active outside. Engage with the kids and rejuvenate yourself.
